424    protected static $title = [
425        'Bc.', 'Ing.', 'MUDr.', 'MVDr.', 'Mgr.', 'JUDr.', 'PhDr.', 'RNDr.', 'doc.', 'Dr.',
426    ];
427
428    /**
429     * @param string|null $gender 'male', 'female' or null for any
430     * @param int         $minAge minimal age of "generated person" in years
431     * @param int         $maxAge maximal age of "generated person" in years
432     *
433     * @return string czech birth number
434     */
435    public function birthNumber($gender = null, $minAge = 0, $maxAge = 100, $slashProbability = 50)
436    {
437        if ($gender === null) {
438            $gender = $this->generator->boolean() ? static::GENDER_MALE : static::GENDER_FEMALE;
439        }
440
441        $startTimestamp = strtotime(sprintf('-%d year', $maxAge));
442        $endTimestamp = strtotime(sprintf('-%d year', $minAge));
443        $randTimestamp = self::numberBetween($startTimestamp, $endTimestamp);
444
445        $year = (int) (date('Y', $randTimestamp));
446        $month = (int) (date('n', $randTimestamp));
447        $day = (int) (date('j', $randTimestamp));
448        $suffix = self::numberBetween(0, 999);
449
450        // women has +50 to month
451        if ($gender == static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
452            $month += 50;
453        }
454
455        // from year 2004 everyone has +20 to month when birth numbers in one day are exhausted
456        if ($year >= 2004 && $this->generator->boolean(10)) {
457            $month += 20;
458        }
459
460        $birthNumber = sprintf('%02d%02d%02d%03d', $year % 100, $month, $day, $suffix);
461
462        // from year 1954 birth number includes CRC
463        if ($year >= 1954) {
464            $crc = intval($birthNumber, 10) % 11;
465
466            if ($crc == 10) {
467                $crc = 0;
468            }
469            $birthNumber .= sprintf('%d', $crc);
470        }
471
472        // add slash
473        if ($this->generator->boolean($slashProbability)) {
474            $birthNumber = substr($birthNumber, 0, 6) . '/' . substr($birthNumber, 6);
475        }
476
477        return $birthNumber;
478    }
479
480    public static function birthNumberMale()
481    {
482        return static::birthNumber(static::GENDER_MALE);
483    }
484
485    public static function birthNumberFemale()
486    {
487        return static::birthNumber(static::GENDER_FEMALE);
488    }
489
490    public function title($gender = null)
491    {
492        return static::titleMale();
493    }
494
495    /**
496     * replaced by specific unisex Czech title
497     */
498    public static function titleMale()
499    {
500        return static::randomElement(static::$title);
501    }
502
503    /**
504     * replaced by specific unisex Czech title
505     */
506    public static function titleFemale()
507    {
508        return static::titleMale();
509    }

511    /**
512     * @param string|null $gender 'male', 'female' or null for any
513     *
514     * @example 'Albrecht'
515     */
516    public function lastName($gender = null)
517    {
518        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
519            return static::lastNameMale();
520        }
521
522        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
523            return static::lastNameFemale();
524        }
525
526        return $this->generator->parse(static::randomElement(static::$lastNameFormat));
527    }
528
529    public static function lastNameMale()
530    {
531        return static::randomElement(static::$lastNameMale);
